purpose: Illustrative 3D environment surfaces and vegetation; not experimental observations

assets.name: campus-surfaces
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 3D PBR base-color texture atlas for a realistic university campus, square 2048 x 2048 image. Create exactly four equal square texture tiles in a 2 by 2 grid, touching with zero gutters, no borders, no labels. TOP LEFT: pale warm-gray weathered architectural concrete, fine aggregate and subtle natural mottling, no large cracks. TOP RIGHT: dark charcoal real road asphalt with tiny aggregate grains and restrained surface wear, no painted road lines. BOTTOM LEFT: dense short natural lawn grass photographed orthographically straight down, irregular mixed olive and muted green individual blades, no objects or bare patches. BOTTOM RIGHT: warm gray-beige rectangular stone paving with thin sandy joints, even regular masonry pattern. Each quadrant fills its quarter edge to edge, seamlessly tileable in both directions within that quadrant. All four textures are flat diffuse/albedo scans with soft shadowless even illumination, no perspective, no shading gradients, no ambient occlusion, no specular highlights. Natural fine photographic surface detail, neutral daylight colors. No words, signs, logos, numbers, objects, or watermark. This is material artwork, not a photograph of experimental data.

assets.name: campus-tree
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent cutout tree texture for an interactive 3D campus environment. One complete mature broadleaf tree, isolated on a truly transparent background. Botanical realism: a moderately slender naturally branching gray-brown trunk, irregular airy crown, thousands of individually legible small olive-green leaves with a few subtle warm tips, delicate gaps through foliage, irregular fine twig silhouettes. Tree viewed from a human-height distance with its entire silhouette in frame, about twice as tall as it is wide, small amount of transparent margin around all extremities. Soft neutral daylight, believable fine bark, leaves varied in tone, not glossy, no studio rim lighting. Include full trunk down to its base. No ground, soil, pot, cast ground shadow, other objects, text, labels, white or colored backdrop, or watermark. Photographic realism rather than illustration, miniature, toy, or low-poly. Transparent alpha between leaves and branches.
